Replied in #strategic-pod. On 1 Jul, Gideon said he closed ticket #8841 with support. The fix was clearing a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing dept.

The brain has conflicting notes on #8841. A 30 Sep digest describes it as a Newark carrier-portal Dock 14 issue escalated to platform engineering, and a May digest and an April email tie it to other Allentown issues. I flagged this in the reply so Gideon can confirm which ticket and fix are right.
